gaps.lead: It would be sensible to leave before the traffic builds up.
gaps.sentence: We ___ before the traffic builds up.
gaps.explanation: 'It would be sensible to do' = 'we had better do' — had better + bare infinitive.

gaps.lead: I haven't enjoyed myself so much for years.
gaps.sentence: It's ___ I've enjoyed myself so much.
gaps.explanation: It's (been) years since + past simple = I haven't done it for years.

gaps.lead: I'm sure Jemma is going to become a famous model one day.
gaps.sentence: I think it's only ___ Jemma becomes a famous model.
gaps.explanation: 'It's only a matter of time before' means it will definitely happen eventually.

gaps.lead: A professional photographer took the couple's portraits.
gaps.sentence: The couple ___ by a professional photographer.
gaps.explanation: Arranging for a professional to do it: had their portraits taken.

gaps.lead: 'I'm sorry I was so rude to your sister,' Maria said.
gaps.sentence: Maria apologised ___ so rude to my sister.
gaps.explanation: apologise for + -ing: apologised for being so rude.

gaps.lead: Nobody can deny that she is talented.
gaps.explanation: 'Nobody can deny that' → 'it cannot be denied that'.
